description: This file defines the AutoApprovalHandler class responsible for managing auto-approval logic based on request count and cost limits, including user prompts for approval when thresholds are exceeded.

classes.name: AutoApprovalHandler
classes.description: Handles auto-approval logic, including request and cost limit checks, user prompts, and state management.

methods.name: checkAutoApprovalLimits
methods.description: Checks if auto-approval limits are reached and handles user approval if needed.

methods.name: checkRequestLimit
methods.description: Calculates request count and determines if limit is exceeded, prompting user if necessary.

methods.name: checkCostLimit
methods.description: Calculates total cost and determines if limit is exceeded, prompting user if necessary.

methods.name: resetRequestCount
methods.description: Resets internal counters and state for new tasks.

methods.name: getApprovalState
methods.description: Returns current request count and cost for debugging or testing.
